digest.component_or_area: MCP server health check and readiness gate
propositions: The /health endpoint returns 200 without validating that the ticket store exists, allowing storeless containers to pass readiness checks and be promoted
The MCP boot sequence guards store initialization with os.path.isdir() and emits no log output when the store is absent, making failures invisible to monitoring
The readiness gate must report store status as {path, present, expected} and refuse promotion only when expected=true AND present=false to avoid blocking deployments before a store is provisioned

The expected flag must be determined solely from REBAR_TRACKER_DIR environment variable to avoid coupling health probes to config parsing and to gracefully degrade for deployments with default store paths
The store_status() probe must never raise exceptions and must handle malformed signals by failing open to prevent restart loops under restart:always policy
Boot must emit exactly one warning log line naming the store path when the store is absent
